blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `createOrderShippingMethods` method. This belongs to the Order Module.
You should only use this methods when implementing complex customizations. For common cases, check out [available workflows instead](/medusa-workflows-reference).
This method creates a shipping method.

```ts
const shippingMethod = await orderModuleService.createOrderShippingMethods({
  name: "Express Shipping",
  order_id: "123",
  amount: 10
})
```
